description: Lists settlement cycles whose net payout differs from the expected net by more than 5% of gross, with total estimated leakage. Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Snapdeal; default last 90 days. Estimates against a per-channel baseline fee %, not the seller's rate card.

channel.description: Limit to one channel. Default: all five.

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). Default: 90 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.
